fields.Description: This archive page from the International Cheese Federation showcases blog posts from July 2019, covering diverse topics such as member spotlights on distributors and retailers, judge accreditation requirements, market trends in the cheese industry, educational workshops on cheesemaking, and recaps from the annual conference and webinars.

Tight stocks, a firm block market, and a reopened export lane
